activity.notes: In May 1694 Henry Every led the mutiny aboard Charles II, was elected captain, renamed the vessel Fancy, and led the pirate company. World History Encyclopedia records that the crews led by Every disbanded in the Caribbean in April 1696 after the 1695 capture of the Mughal treasure ship Ganj-i-Sawai.
